claim: The ABCA1-versus-ABCG1 RNA split seen after Pmp22 transgenesis and Acly loss also occurs under an acute non-lipid-specific Schwann perturbation, consistent with a broader state response rather than a lipid-specific feedback signature.
context: GSE104324, adult rat primary Schwann cultures, 10 nM soluble NRG1beta1 for 6 h versus vehicle; three independent experiments reported, donor/split identity unresolved.
baseline_model: A uniform efflux response moves Abca1 and Abcg1 together; a general repair/dedifferentiation program may instead produce Abca1 induction with Abcg1 repression, without requiring primary lipid disruption.
discovery_sources: GSE115930 P18 Pmp22 transgenic versus WT
validation_sources: GSE104324 6-hour NRG1beta1 versus vehicle; native inputs linked by post_e464a87a23c24cea85127b31d3bee6aa
prior_exposure: Parent ABCA1 efflux literature known; discovery gene effects and Acly source discussion inspected. Peer report reveals GSE104324 Pmp22/myelin7 effects and design. Abca1 and Abcg1 outcomes for GSE104324 have not been inspected in this session; model prior knowledge cannot be excluded. Local artifact show returned unknown_artifact before fetch; no validation gene table was read. This is a prospective in-session contextual-transfer test, not a blinded experiment or like-for-like disease replication.
prediction: NRG1 versus vehicle: delta(log2 Abca1 - log2 Abcg1) >=0.5, with Abca1 delta>0 and Abcg1 delta<0. This direction would undermine lipid specificity of the discovered split.
analysis_plan: Use native complete gene counts and the source-defined six libraries. Confirm unique literal Abca1/Abcg1 rows, control mean normalized count>=10, and at least three labelled experiment libraries/arm. Median-of-ratios within contrast; log2(normalized+0.5). Do not assume pairs from suffixes. Estimate sample log-ratio contrast, Welch 95% interval and all 20 label assignments as a conditional unpaired check; CPM sensitivity. No raw processing. Reuse peer exact input bytes, not its code. Retain both gene effects and every sample.
success_rule: All eligibility rules satisfied, point log-ratio contrast >=0.5 with Abca1 positive and Abcg1 negative. Uncertainty crossing zero qualifies as weak point transfer, not statistical corroboration; interval wholly above zero is stronger conditional support.
failure_rule: Eligible contrast with log-ratio delta<0.5 or either component sign contrary to prediction fails this stated transfer prediction. Missing/floor/control failures make it untestable. Failure does not establish lipid specificity because timing, age and preparation also differ.
confounder_checks: NRG1 effect on cell state rather than lipid mechanism
unresolved donor pairing and pool identities
published source outcome exposure and no promoter/flux assay
selection_and_multiplicity: One post-discovery candidate selected from the prespecified three export genes after finding cancellation in the module mean. One predeclared validation contrast; no replacement timing/gene pair if it fails. Discovery all-gene and fixed-module backgrounds remain retained. No novel mechanism claim from this test alone.
